decisions.reason: The images-only instruction concerns filling article-ending whitespace; it does not change the separate treatment of articles containing too much uninterrupted text.
The instruction about using supplied images without extra text does not affect author names, photographs, sizing, shape, or source.
Selecting images rather than extra text to fill empty spaces does not alter the confirmed Inter typeface or its weight treatment.
The page-specific fill-content restriction does not change the magazine's overall brand alignment, visual style, or red-color rule.
The separate final-PDF handoff clause from message 145 is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the whitespace instruction requires no further change.
Using only supplied images to address article-ending whitespace does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy.
The fill-content decision does not change article order, pagination basis, tribute placement, or placement of cover-referenced articles.
The distinct Heyzine clause in message 145 is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and RESUME; the whitespace decision requires no additional hosting change.
The instruction identifies which images may be used as fill content but does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The prohibition on extra fill text does not remove or alter any required article or tribute-page content.
The source concerns supplied page-specific images for article whitespace and does not change the advertisement rendering-quality requirement.
The selected whitespace-fill content does not change the launch deadline or required live-launch state.
